referenceSources.description:
A blue 1966 Morris Mini Cooper S MK1, fitted with a white roof and sporting the racing number 70, stands ready on a grassy paddock. Period sponsor decals—Castrol, Ferodo, Champion, Burmah, and Dunlop—adorn its flanks, while driver names Conor O'Brien, John Rhodes, and Barrie Williams appear above the door. The car’s front grille, round headlights, and leather bonnet strap evoke its classic 1960s rally heritage.

This genuine FIA-spec Mini has undergone a comprehensive Swiftune works-spec upgrade, including a fresh 1275cc engine, Koni dampers, oil cooler, racing seats with harnesses, and a full plumbing and electrical overhaul. With HTP papers, a heritage certificate, and a competition history in HGTCC, Masters, and HRCA events, it represents a rare opportunity to own an authentic 1966 Cooper S ready for historic racing.
